title: Fieldwise record equality between the abstract and executable seL4 states (absKState_correct)
intent: Prove that the executable specification's observable state `absKState s'` equals the abstract state `abs_state s` by `state.equality`, which splits the equality of the two state records into one subgoal per field; each non-trivial field is closed by a named, independently proved lemma, so the headline correspondence becomes nine field lemmas joined by a 28-line glue.

parent.name: absKState_correct
parent.statement:
lemma absKState_correct:
  assumes invs: "einvs (s :: det_ext state)" and invs': "invs' s'"
  assumes rel: "(s,s') \<in> state_relation"
  shows "absKState s' = abs_state s"

children.name: absIsOriginalCap_correct
children.statement:
lemma absIsOriginalCap_correct:
  assumes valid_ioc: "valid_ioc s"
  assumes valid_objs: "valid_objs s"
  assumes rel: "(s,s') \<in> state_relation"
  assumes pspace_aligned: "pspace_aligned s"
  assumes pspace_distinct: "pspace_distinct s"
  assumes pspace_aligned': "pspace_aligned' s'"
  assumes pspace_distinct': "pspace_distinct' s'"
  shows "absIsOriginalCap (cteMap (gsCNodes s')) (ksPSpace s') = is_original_cap s"
children.closed_by: apply (rule ext) over the cap pair, case on caps_of_state, using cnp (from cteMap_correct) and revokable_relation
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: the absIsOriginalCap projection onto the cte map equals is_original_cap, under valid_ioc / valid_objs / state_relation / pspace_aligned and pspace_distinct on both sides (paraphrase)

children.name: absSchedulerAction_correct

lemma absSchedulerAction_correct:
  "sched_act_relation action action' \<Longrightarrow> absSchedulerAction action' = action"
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: absSchedulerAction applied to a sched_act_relation-related action gives the abstract action back (paraphrase)

children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: domSchedule_map of the executable domain schedule equals the abstract domain_list, under state_relation (paraphrase)

lemma absInterruptIRQNode_correct:
  "interrupt_state_relation (interrupt_irq_node s) (interrupt_states s) (ksInterruptState s') \<Longrightarrow>

children.closed_by: by (rule ext) (clarsimp simp add: absInterruptIRQNode_def interrupt_state_relation_def)

lemma absExst_correct:
  assumes invs: "einvs s" and invs': "invs' s'"

applicability.goal_shape: An equality `absKState s' = abs_state s` between two large record-typed states (a `det_ext state` and the projection `absKState s'` of a `kernel_state`), where record equality is definitionally a conjunction of per-field equalities and a `state_relation` between the two sides already fixes most fields directly.
applicability.use_when: the two records have matching fields and a relation that already states most field equalities as direct components (so `simp add: state_relation_def` closes them); each genuinely hard field can be stated as its own named lemma or locale parameter; the fields are independent enough to prove separately.
applicability.avoid_when: fields interact (proving one field needs another's proof) so the per-field split does not separate concerns; there is no fieldwise relation to exploit, so each field needs a genuinely new argument rather than a one-line `rule`; or the record is small enough that the `state.equality` split is ceremony with no gain.

consequences: The move creates one obligation per field of the state record. Each is discharged either by `simp add: state_relation_def` (a field whose equality is a direct component of the relation) or by a named lemma/parameter. The two heaviest fields (kheap and arch_state) are left as locale parameters, so the generic refine layer does not prove them: the obligation moves to the per-architecture interpretation (e.g. ARM/ArchADT_H.thy). Failure modes: a field missing from `state_relation`, or a child stated slightly weaker than the field equality, breaks the corresponding `apply (rule ...)` step in the glue; a record that is later extended by a field silently adds a subgoal that `simp_all` must then handle.
